intro.text: The Open Finance Insurance Data Sharing capabilities enable secure, consent-driven access to a customer’s insurance policy data across the UAE’s major sectors. These services empower licensed third-party providers (TPPs) to deliver policy aggregation, switching support, broking, claims assistance, and value-added digital insurance services.
All data access operates under explicit customer consent, with granular permission scopes, strict expiry controls, and full auditability.

blocks.text: Access to the Insurance Data Sharing APIs requires the ISP role. This role must be assigned to your application in the Trust Framework before making any insurance policy requests. See Roles for the full list of scopes and grant types this role permits.
Each insurance type has its own pair of endpoints — a list endpoint and a per-policy detail endpoint. An LFI exposes the endpoints for the types it underwrites.
